offerings.name: Reader for web search and SERP
offerings.pricing: API pricing is based on token usage. Prototype Development: $50 for 1 Billion tokens ($0.050 / 1M tokens); Production Deployment: $500 for 11 Billion tokens ($0.045 / 1M tokens).
offerings.price_basis: Jina Search Foundation API token top-up；搜索请求固定消耗 token，起始为 10,000 tokens
offerings.free_quota: Every new API key comes with 10M free tokens; Non-commercial use only (CC-BY-NC).
offerings.output_type: 返回前五个搜索结果及其 URL 和网页内容，转换为适合 LLM 的干净文本；JSON 模式返回五个条目列表
offerings.note: 端点 https://s.jina.ai；免费/付费 key 为100 RPM，高级 key 为1000 RPM；每次请求从10000 tokens起计
